title: WoDX Creation
description: World of Darkness Expanded: the Embrace, ghouls and the blood oath, death into a wraith, the Awakening, a creation check against each book's totals, lineage, the experience log with each line's book costs and the Storyteller's approval, Pass the Years, and the sheet for the Group actor (coterie, pack, cabal...). Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
